context.goal: Ensure late-joining viewers in NW.js still receive document_info, and verify full remote debug workflow end-to-end.

problem.symptom: NW.js E2E viewer sometimes missed document_info and failed validation
problem.root_cause: document_info was broadcast only at send-time; viewers connecting after the event did not receive it

change.summary: Cache latest documentInfo per channel and emit it to viewers on connect/registered; update lastActivity when document_info arrives.

verification.nwjs: Launched NW wrapper with file:// target/site + remote-debug params; server /api/channels showed hasAgent:true

docs: docs/remote_dbg.md updated: Document Info behavior described
